decisions.rationale: Leading Charizard and Venusaur applies immediate Sun offense and Chlorophyll speed pressure. In Sun, Venusaur outspeeds the opponent's entire team, threatening heavy Sludge Bomb damage on Gardevoir/Hatterene and Sleep Powder setup denial. Charizard's Drought boosts Heat Wave/Overheat to KO TR setters and Kingambit. In the back, Swampert provides Wide Guard protection against spread moves (Hyper Voice, Rock Slide) and Yawn to slow down TR, while Hisuian Goodra walls opposing special attacks and t
decisions.notebook: Matchup build carried from teambuilding. Plan: Leverage Sun offense (Mega Charizard Y + Chlorophyll Venusaur) to overpower opponent speed control and disrupt TR setters. Wide Guard on Swampert and Garganacl neutralizes Mega Gardevoir's Pixilate Hyper Voice, Hatterene's Dazzling Gleam, and H-Arcanine's Rock Slide. Hisuian Goodra provides an unshakeable special wall resisting Psychic/Fairy/Dragon/Normal attacks, while Swampert provides Yawn and Ground coverage.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf+Hatterene lead: dual Trick Room setters. Armor Tail blocks priority, Magic Bounce reflects Venusaur Sleep Powder. Farigiraf immune to Dragapult Shadow Ball. Both survive sun-boosted Charizard Y Heat Wave (53-76%). Kingambit cleans late-game under Trick Room with Supreme Overlord. Gardevoir provides backup Trick Room + Pixilate Hyper Voice spread.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Leading Farigiraf+Hatterene, Kingambit+Gardevoir back. Opponent sun team (Charizard Y, Venusaur, Dragapult, Swampert/Goodra-H/Garganacl). Magic Bounce key vs Sleep Powder. Plan: set Trick Room turn 1, sweep with slow breakers. Kingambit Supreme Overlord gains power as allies faint.

decisions.rationale: Mega Charizard Y sets Sun, doubling Modest Life Orb Venusaur's Speed to 264. Venusaur's Sludge Bomb (88.4-161.4%) combined with Charizard's Sun-boosted Heat Wave (37.8-71.2%) guarantees a KO on Hatterene before it can act if it does not Protect, while also chunking Farigiraf. Heat Wave avoids the SpA drop from Overheat and breaks focus/chips both targets.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 Turn 1: Lead Mega Charizard Y + Chlorophyll Venusaur against Farigiraf + Hatterene. Farigiraf has Mental Herb and no Protect; Hatterene has Life Orb and Magic Bounce. Sun doubles Venusaur's speed. Swampert with Wide Guard and Hisuian Goodra in back counter Trick Room sweepers.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Hatterene)
decisions.rationale: Only one Trick Room must be used to avoid self-cancel. Farigiraf sets TR while Hatterene Protects. Hatterene is the bigger offensive threat and more likely to be double-targeted; Protect keeps it safe. Farigiraf is slightly bulkier against their special attacks (neutral to Sludge Bomb vs Hatterene's 2x weakness). If they double Farigiraf it may faint, but TR is the priority and Hatterene survives to sweep under it.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Leading Farigiraf+Hatterene, Kingambit+Gardevoir back. Opponent sun team (Charizard Y, Venusaur, Dragapult, Swampert/Goodra-H/Garganacl). Magic Bounce key vs Sleep Powder. Plan: set Trick Room turn 1, sweep with slow breakers. Kingambit Supreme Overlord gains power as allies faint. Only one TR setter per turn to avoid cancel.

decisions.rationale: Under Trick Room, Chlorophyll Venusaur (264) and Charizard-Mega-Y (167) move last. Hatterene and Farigiraf threaten a KO on Venusaur with STAB Psychic. Charizard uses Protect to block incoming attacks safely, while Venusaur switches out to Goodra-Hisui, who quad-resists Psychic and easily absorbs Hatterene and Farigiraf's attacks.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 Turn 1: Lead Mega Charizard Y + Chlorophyll Venusaur against Farigiraf + Hatterene. Farigiraf used Trick Room; Hatterene Protected. Turn 2: TR active (4 turns). Charizard Protects while Venusaur switches to Goodra-Hisui to absorb incoming Psychic attacks.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf Helping Hand (+5 priority) boosts Hatterene before it moves. Hatterene Life Orb Psychic with Helping Hand guarantees OHKO on Venusaur (132-289%), removing the Sludge Bomb threat before it can target Hatterene. Farigiraf is likely KO'd by Charizard Heat Wave afterward, but Venusaur's removal is worth the trade. Kingambit enters with +1 Supreme Overlord.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Leading Farigiraf+Hatterene, Kingambit+Gardevoir back. Opponent sun team (Charizard Y, Venusaur, Dragapult, Swampert/Goodra-H/Garganacl). Turn 1: Trick Room set, Hatterene Protected, Farigiraf took Heat Wave to 40%. Turn 2: Helping Hand + Psychic to eliminate Venusaur. Priority: remove Venusaur first (Sludge Bomb threatens Hatterene; Sleep Powder threatens Farigiraf). Kingambit Supreme Overlord gains power as allies faint. Gardevoir-Mega is late-game cleaner. Track Trick Room duration (4 turns remaining after turn 2).

decisions.rationale: In Sun, Charizard's Heat Wave does 46.3-85.1% to Farigiraf, guaranteeing a KO on its 39% HP. Heat Wave also hits Hatterene for 50-92.4%, while Goodra's Flash Cannon deals 65.2-118.2% to Hatterene, ensuring a KO on Hatterene if it does not Protect. Neither opponent can KO Charizard or Goodra this turn.
decisions.notebook: G1: Foe brought Farigiraf (Quiet, Mental Herb) and Hatterene (Quiet, Life Orb). Foe open sheet contains Mega Gardevoir, Kingambit (Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord), Hisuian Arcanine (Focus Sash, Intimidate), Milotic (Bold, Leftovers, Competitive).

decisions.rationale: Swampert is significantly slower (Speed 72) than Venusaur (132, doubled in Sun to 264), allowing it to act much earlier under the remaining 3 turns of Trick Room. Swampert's Ground coverage (High Horsepower) is strong against Farigiraf and potential incoming physical threats like Kingambit or Hisuian Arcanine.
decisions.notebook: G1: Foe brought Farigiraf (Quiet, Mental Herb) and Hatterene (Quiet, Life Orb). Foe bench: Gardevoir, Kingambit, H-Arcanine, Milotic. Hatterene KOed T3 by Goodra Flash Cannon; Charizard KOed T3. Trick Room has 3 turns left, Sun has 3 turns left. Swampert brought in to leverage TR.

decisions.rationale: Double Psychic into Charizard Y under Trick Room: Hatterene (44 Speed) then Farigiraf (72) both move before Goodra and Charizard. Combined damage 74.6–131.3% nearly guarantees the KO, removing the Sun setter and Heat Wave threat. Farigiraf at 40% would otherwise fall to Heat Wave; this way it survives if Charizard goes down. Goodra's Flash Cannon threatens Hatterene (65–118%) but Hatterene gets its attack off first.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Leading Farigiraf+Hatterene, Kingambit+Gardevoir back. Opponent sun team (Charizard Y, Venusaur, Goodra-H, Dragapult, Swampert, Garganacl). Turn 1: Trick Room set, Hatterene Protected, Farigiraf took Heat Wave to 40%. Turn 2: Helping Hand + Psychic into Goodra-H (72% after Leftovers). Venusaur eliminated turn 2. Turn 3: Trick Room 3 turns left, Sun 3 turns left. Double Psychic into Charizard for near-guaranteed KO. Kingambit Supreme Overlord gains power as allies faint. Gardevoir-Mega is late-game cleaner. Priority: remove Charizard to eliminate Sun and spread damage.

decisions.rationale: Kingambit resists both of Goodra-H's special moves (Flash Cannon 11-26%, Draco Meteor 18-42%) while Gardevoir takes 46-101% from Flash Cannon. Kingambit's Kowtow Cleave with Black Glasses + Supreme Overlord (2 fainted allies) does 34-75% to Goodra-H. Farigiraf is likely KO'd this turn regardless; Kingambit sets up a strong TR position.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent sun team (Charizard Y, Venusaur, Goodra-H, Dragapult, Swampert, Garganacl). Charizard Y fainted turn 3. Goodra-H at ~78%, Modest nature, moves: Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, Body Press, Protect. Venusaur Modest Chlorophyll Life Orb (Sludge Bomb, Solar Beam, Earth Power, Sleep Powder). Dragapult Timid Focus Sash Infiltrator. Swampert Relaxed Sitrus Berry Torrent. Garganacl Impish Soft Sand Purifying Salt. Kingambit Supreme Overlord gains power per fainted ally. Gardevoir-Mega is late-game cleaner with Pixilate Hyper Voice. Trick Room + Sun both expire in 3 turns.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf has no Protect on its set and is at 39% HP; Goodra's Draco Meteor deals 42.7-97.4%, guaranteeing the KO. SpA drops do not affect Goodra's Body Press defense scaling. Swampert targets Kingambit with High Horsepower (36.7-76.6%) to break through or punish if Kingambit does not Protect.
decisions.notebook: G1 T4: Opponent active Farigiraf (39% HP, TR/Psychic/HyperVoice/HH) and Kingambit (100% HP, Sucker/Kowtow/IronHead/Protect, BlackGlasses, SupremeOverlord). Farigiraf lacks Protect. Draco Meteor guarantees KO on Farigiraf. Goodra Body Press scales off Def so SpA drop from Draco Meteor is harmless vs Kingambit.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Goodra Body Press 98-144% OHKO range on Kingambit is the biggest threat. Helping Hand (+5 priority) guarantees Farigiraf boosts Kingambit before Kowtow Cleave. Boosted Kowtow Cleave does 63-112% into 78% Goodra; if it KOs, Kingambit survives. Swampert High Horsepower also OHKOs but moves after Kingambit under TR. Aggressive play to remove the Body Press threat immediately.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Trick Room + Sun both expire in 2 turns. Opponent has Venusaur (Chlorophyll Life Orb Modest, Sludge Bomb/SolarBeam/EarthPower/SleepPowder) in back. My Gardevoir (Mega-capable, Pixilate Hyper Voice) also in back. Kingambit Supreme Overlord has 1 stack. Goodra-Hisui Body Press is 4x into Kingambit (98-144% OHKO range). Swampert High Horsepower also OHKOs Kingambit. Need to eliminate Goodra first to preserve Kingambit.

decisions.rationale: Trick Room and Sun end after this turn. Farigiraf (39% HP) dies guaranteed to Venusaur's Sludge Bomb (40.5–74.4%). Swampert's High Horsepower into Kingambit (46% HP) deals 40.1–68.6%, threatening a KO if Kingambit attacks. Splitting targets ensures Farigiraf is eliminated even if Kingambit uses Protect, positioning us to outspeed and finish Kingambit on Turn 6 once Trick Room expires.
decisions.notebook: G1 T5: Farigiraf (39% HP) and Kingambit (46% HP, BlackGlasses, SupremeOverlord fallen1) active under last turn of TR and Sun. Venusaur LO Sludge Bomb guarantees KO on Farigiraf; Swampert High Horsepower deals 40.1-68.6% to Kingambit. Out of TR, Venusaur (132 speed) naturally outspeeds Kingambit (63-91 speed) and Farigiraf (72-100 speed).

decisions.rationale: Kingambit must Protect to survive both Swampert High Horsepower (OHKO) and Venusaur EarthPower (43-93%). Farigiraf Psychic into Venusaur has 65-116% range — a solid OHKO chance. TR and Sun expire after this turn regardless, so preserving Kingambit for the post-weather endgame with Gardevoir-Mega is paramount. Even if Venusaur lives, Farigiraf is expendable and Gardevoir enters safely.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Trick Room and Sun both expire after turn 5. Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate) is backline anchor — Mega Evolve on entry, Hyper Voice becomes Fairy-type 1.2x boosted. Venusaur without Sun/Chlorophyll is base 80 Speed (100-132 Modest). Kingambit Supreme Overlord has 1 fallen ally stack. Swampert has Sitrus Berry intact. Opponent has no remaining backline after Venusaur and Swampert.

decisions.rationale: Swampert (100% HP, Sitrus Berry) easily survives incoming hits from Kingambit and Farigiraf combined. Kingambit is at 46% HP, well within High Horsepower's KO range after dealing 54% on turn 4. Removing Kingambit leaves Farigiraf unable to race Swampert 1v1.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent brought Farigiraf (Mental Herb, TR/Psychic/Hyper Voice/Helping Hand), Hatterene (Life Orb, TR/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect), Kingambit (BlackGlasses, Supreme Overlord, Sucker Punch/Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Protect), and unknown fourth. Swampert High Horsepower 2HKOes Kingambit.

decisions.rationale: 3v1 lead. Switch Farigiraf to Gardevoir to preserve it and bring fresh Mega; Kingambit Sucker Punch outspeeds any attacking move for 30–55% chip. If Swampert High Horsepowers Kingambit (likely KO at 47%), Gardevoir-Mega enters freely and outspeeds next turn for the clean Psychic finish. If Swampert Yawns, Sucker Punch fails but we still have Gardevoir-Mega + drowsy Kingambit vs lone Swampert.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate, Modest, 120–152 Speed) is backline anchor. Opponent down to lone Swampert. Next turn Gardevoir-Mega outspeeds and can Psychic for 35–74%; combined with Sucker Punch chip, KO through Sitrus is likely. Farigiraf preserved at 40%.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.
High Horsepower into Farigiraf attempts to pick off the weakened Farigiraf before Swampert faints to faster Psychic attacks from Mega Gardevoir / Farigiraf outside Trick Room.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 Summary: Opponent brought Farigiraf (Mental Herb, Quiet: TR/Psychic/Hyper Voice/Helping Hand), Hatterene (Life Orb, Quiet: TR/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect), Kingambit (BlackGlasses, Brave, Supreme Overlord: Sucker Punch/Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Protect), and Gardevoir (Gardevoirite, Modest: Hyper Voice/Psychic/TR/Protect). Unbrought: Arcanine-Hisui, Milotic. Opponent plays hard TR mode. Goodra-Hisui KOes Hatterene with Flash Cannon; Swampert 2HKOes Kingambit with High Horsepower.

decisions.rationale: Mega Evolve Gardevoir (SpA 238, Spe 128) and Helping Hand-boosted Psychic deals 62.3–111.5% to Swampert. ~92% chance to OHKO through Sitrus Berry. Helping Hand's +5 priority ensures Farigiraf boosts before Swampert moves; Gardevoir-Mega then outspeeds 72–100 Speed Swampert. If the min roll fails, Swampert survives at ~29% and Gardevoir finishes next turn. No downside to Mega Evolving now.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate, Modest, 128 Spe post-Mega) is backline anchor. Farigiraf has Armor Tail (blocks priority). Opponent's Swampert is Torrent (Relaxed, 72–100 Spe) with Sitrus Berry, High Horsepower, Flip Turn, Yawn, Wide Guard. Both teams down to these three.

reflections.summary: Bringing fast sun sweepers (Charizard-Y and Chlorophyll Venusaur) into a hard Trick Room composition allowed the opponent's Farigiraf/Hatterene setup to easily control turn order and pick off our frail attackers with Helping Hand-boosted Psychics.
reflections.adjustment: Pivot away from leading sun sweepers at Team Preview against their hard TR core; instead, lead bulky disruptors like Swampert and Goodra-Hisui to stall TR turns using Wide Guard and Yawn before bringing in late-game clean-up options.
reflections.notebook: Opponent hard TR composition: Farigiraf (Mental Herb, Quiet: TR/Psychic/Hyper Voice/Helping Hand), Hatterene (Life Orb, Quiet: TR/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect), Kingambit (BlackGlasses, Brave, Supreme Overlord: Sucker Punch/Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Protect), Gardevoir-Mega (Modest: Hyper Voice/Psychic/TR/Protect). Unbrought: Arcanine-Hisui, Milotic. Strategic Fact: Farigiraf carries Mental Herb (immune to Taunt) and Armor Tail (blocks priority). Future Plan: Do not commit fast Sun mode (Charizard-Y/Venusaur) early into hard TR; prioritize Swampert's Wide Guard and Yawn to survive TR windows.

reflections.summary: We won because we successfully set Trick Room and used Helping Hand-boosted attacks to KO their fast sun threats before they could move. Opponent lacked Trick Room denial and their speed-reliant team was reversed.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, expect Dragapult and Garganacl. Lead Farigiraf + Hatterene again, but use Protect on Hatterene turn 1 if Dragapult is present to block Will-O-Wisp, then set Trick Room. Preserve Kingambit for late-game and avoid burn. Use single-target moves to bypass Wide Guard.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's full team: Charizard-Y (Timid, sun setter), Venusaur (Chlorophyll, Life Orb, Sleep Powder), Swampert (Relaxed, Yawn, Wide Guard, Sitrus), Goodra-Hisui (Sap Sipper, Leftovers, special wall), Dragapult (Timid, Focus Sash, Will-O-Wisp, U-turn), Garganacl (Impish, Wide Guard, Salt Cure, Recover). Game 1 they brought Charizard, Venusaur, Swampert, Goodra; no Trick Room counter. Our Trick Room mode with Hatterene + Farigiraf + Kingambit + Gardevoir-Mega overwhelmed them. For game 2, they will likely bring Dragapult and Garganacl to disrupt TR and stall. Dragapult threatens Will-O-Wisp on Kingambit; Garganacl has Wide Guard. We must adapt by protecting Hatterene from status, using single-target moves, and possibly bringing a different support if available. Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks priority, but Dragapult has none. Gardevoir-Mega remains our anchor.
